rows.reimbursement_conditions: Reimburses observation only if medically necessary, properly ordered, supervised, and meeting qualifying encounter criteria.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Observation services are reimbursable only when medically necessary, ordered by a qualified healthcare professional, and provided while the patient is under physician or qualified nonphysician practitioner care. At least one qualifying encounter condition must be present. If none apply, the facility observation charge is not reimbursed. Billable observation time is typically limited to 48 hours, and several intervals are excluded from the count. Documentation is required to support billing.

utilization_limits: standard recovery period 4 to 6 hours excluded
state_specific_rules: Humana Medicaid plans follow state Medicaid guidelines when state rules are more restrictive
provider_role_restrictions: physician or qualified nonphysician practitioner must oversee care
exemptions: Humana Medicaid plans when not permissible by state Medicaid guidelines
